editorial.blurb: A cozy, authentic Japanese izakaya hidden in the suburbs that delivers pristine sushi, comforting ramen, and craveable yakitori with genuinely friendly service.
editorial.insiderTip: Come on a Friday or Saturday night when they're open late and book the karaoke room with friends—the nostalgia-inducing yakitori and chicken skin skewers pair perfectly with an evening of singing.

topDishes.note: Really nice cuts of fish that melt in your mouth
Flavorful broth with just the right balance, absolutely delicious
